plantedErrorDetectionRate.requirement: Point estimate >= 95%, Wilson 95% lower bound >= 90% across 200 planted errors (40 per category across 10 holdout families)

cleanNegativeFalsePositiveRate.requirement: Point estimate <= 10%, Wilson 95% upper bound <= 15% across 200 clean negative paragraphs

unresolvedSevereFabricationsInApproved.requirement: 0 unresolved severe fabrications in approved revisions; enforced by approveStoryRevision and DB trigger trg_prevent_approved_story_revision_overwrite

audioTimestampSeekSpotCheck.requirement: 100/100 random paragraph audio timestamp seek checks resolve to valid [startMs, endMs] ranges
